title.zh: UK Backs Money Laundering Crackdown With $676M and 500 New Officers
title.en: UK Backs Money Laundering Crackdown With $676M and 500 New Officers

current_state.zh: The UK Home Office is committing £500 million over three years and 500 new officers across police, the NCA, and the CPS to a new Anti-Money Laundering and Asset Recovery Strategy targeting criminal money flows, including crypto-related laundering networks.
current_state.en: The UK Home Office is committing £500 million over three years and 500 new officers across police, the NCA, and the CPS to a new Anti-Money Laundering and Asset Recovery Strategy targeting criminal money flows, including crypto-related laundering networks.
